title: fEDM+: A Risk-Based Fuzzy Ethical Decision Making Framework with Principle-Level Explainability and Pluralistic Validation
reasoning: The paper explicitly focuses on 'Ethical Decision Making' (EDM) and moral reasoning in artificial agents. It proposes a framework to map AI actions to ethical principles such as autonomy, beneficence, and non-maleficence, and includes a pluralistic validation process to evaluate decisions against different ethical referents.
